Pixar comes alive

An immersive Pixar exhibition, “Mundo Pixar,” has opened in London’s Wembley Park, marking its first UK appearance after touring Europe. The experience features 14 life-size, interactive sets inspired by iconic Pixar films like Toy Story, Up, Coco, Cars, and Finding Nemo.

Spanning 3,500 square metres, the exhibition offers a one-way walkthrough with detailed environments, soundscapes, and photo opportunities. A London-exclusive room recreates Sunnyside Daycare from Toy Story. The exhibition blends storytelling, design, and interactivity to bring Pixar’s worlds to life.

🔗 Link: Mundo Pixar
📅 When: February 13 to June 28
💸 Cost: Starts from £29
📍 Where: Fulton Road, Wembley

 
 

Stop motion magic

London’s Young V&A is hosting Inside Aardman: Wallace & Gromit and Friends, celebrating 50 years of Aardman Animations. The exhibition offers a behind-the-scenes look at beloved creations like Wallace & Gromit, Shaun the Sheep, Morph, and Chicken Run.

Featuring over 150 archival items, including original sketches, storyboards, and film props, it traces the full stop-motion production pipeline. Designed as an interactive experience, visitors can experiment with animation techniques, lighting, and character design

🔗 Link: Inside Aardman: Wallace & Gromit and Friends
📅 When: February 12 to November 15
💸 Cost: Starts from £12.50
📍 Where: Young V&A

 

Live events

 

Romeo and Juliet

A high-energy adaptation of Romeo and Juliet at Shakespeare's Globe, directed by Lucy Cuthbertson, reimagines the classic for young audiences with action, intensity, and modern relevance.

📅 When: April 9 - April 12 | Tickets start at £5
📍 Where: Globe Theatre

Marie & Rosetta

A vibrant musical about Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Marie Knight, starring Beverley Knight, celebrating their groundbreaking influence on rock, gospel, and music history.

📅 When: April 9 - April 11 | Tickets start at £37
📍 Where: Soho Place

Nightlife

 

The Vault - Restricted Access

The Vault is an exclusive, no-cameras soca night blending luxury, mystery, and high-energy vibes, accessible only via ticket code, promising surprises and a premium bacchanal experience for true insiders.

Everything else

 

Summit at Alexandra Palace

Experience the Alexandra Palace Summit rooftop walk with guided climbs, 360° views, iconic landmarks, and unique history, offering daytime, sunset, or night adventures high above London’s skyline.

📅 When: Multiple dates | Tickets start from £28

Schiaparelli: Fashion Becomes Art

Schiaparelli: Fashion Becomes Art at London’s Victoria and Albert Museum showcases surrealist couture, featuring collaborations with Salvador Dalí and Jean Cocteau, tracing the designer’s transformative influence on fashion and art.

📅 When: Till November 8 | Tickets start from £28
